# request

Send a raw HTTP request to the Dataverse Web API. Note: on Git Bash/MSYS a leading-slash --path (e.g. /api/data/v9.2/accounts) is rewritten into a Windows path before it reaches the CLI; prefix with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1, set MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*', or run from PowerShell/cmd.

## Usage

```
ppds api request [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--body` |  | `string` |  | Request body as inline JSON string |
| `--body-file` |  | `string` |  | Request body from file (mutually exclusive with --body) |
| `--confirm` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass write protection on production environments |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Target environment URL (default: active profile) |
| `--header` | `-H` | `String[]` |  | Additional header, repeatable (format: "Name: Value") |
| `--include` | `-i` | `bool` |  | Include HTTP status line and response headers in output |
| `--method` | `-X` | `string` |  | HTTP method (default: GET) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--path` |  | `string` |  | Relative URL path (e.g., /api/data/v9.2/accounts) |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile to use (default: active profile) |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
